title: Limited Evidence for Non-Invasive Brain Stimulation as a Cognitive Enhancer in Neurodevelopmental Disorders: A Multilevel Meta-Analysis of Sham-Controlled Trials
title_zh: 非侵入性脑刺激作为神经发育障碍认知增强剂的有限证据：七大认知域多水平 sham 对照试验荟萃分析
abstract: Non-invasive brain stimulation (NIBS) is increasingly applied to ameliorate cognitive deficits in neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs), including autism spectrum disorder (ASD), attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), and intellectual disability, yet whether standardized scalp-based protocols produce reliable cognitive enhancement remains untested at scale. This study evaluates the transdiagnostic efficacy of NIBS on shared, non-core cognitive domains across NDDs, searching MEDLINE, PsycINFO, Embase, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library from inception to January 2026. A three-level multivariate random-effects meta-analysis synthesized effect sizes while accounting for dependency among multiple outcomes contributed by the same study. From 9191 identified records (5237 after deduplication), 30 randomized sham-controlled trials yielding 178 effect sizes across seven cognitive domains were synthesized. NIBS did not significantly outperform sham for any domain: working memory (k=24; g=-0.16, 95% CI [-0.37, 0.05]), cognitive flexibility (k=11; g=-0.12 [-0.38, 0.13]), global executive function (k=8; g=-0.14 [-0.46, 0.18]), processing speed (k=8; g=-0.27 [-0.77, 0.23]), inhibitory control (k=4; g=-0.08 [-0.62, 0.46]), verbal fluency (k=5; g=-0.11 [-0.59, 0.38]), or self-monitoring/behavioral metacognition (k=4; g=0.13 [-0.60, 0.86]). The pooled cross-domain estimate reached nominal significance (g=-0.18, p=0.035) but fell below the small-effect threshold, and its wide prediction interval (95% PI [-1.01, 0.66]) spanned benefit and harm. Exploratory diagnosis-stratified analyses were likewise null in both ADHD and ASD (all p>0.10). Current unstandardized, "one-size-fits-all" NIBS protocols do not yield reliable cognitive enhancement across NDDs, exposing a translational bottleneck driven by methodological heterogeneity. Realizing NIBS therapeutic potential for cognition in NDDs will require a shift toward precision psychiatry, utilizing individualized neuro-navigation and state-dependent stimulation.
abstract_zh: 非侵入性脑刺激（NIBS）越来越多地应用于改善神经发育障碍（NDD）的认知缺陷，包括自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）、注意缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）和智力障碍，但标准皮质刺激方案是否能在大规模上产生可靠的认知增强尚未得到检验。本研究评估 NIBS 在 NDD 共同的非核心认知域中的跨诊断疗效，从 inception 到 2026 年 1 月检索 MEDLINE、PsycINFO、Embase、Web of Science 和 Cochrane Library。采用三层多水平随机效应荟萃分析综合效应量，以考虑同一研究贡献的多个结果之间的依赖性。在 9191 条记录中（去重后 5237 条），综合了 30 项随机 sham 对照试验，产生 178 个效应量，涉及七大认知域。NIBS 在任何认知域均未显著优于假刺激：工作记忆（k=24；g=-0.16，95% CI [-0.37, 0.05]），认知灵活性（k=11；g=-0.12 [-0.38, 0.13]），全局执行功能（k=8；g=-0.14 [-0.46, 0.18]），处理速度（k=8；g=-0.27 [-0.77, 0.23]），抑制控制（k=4；g=-0.08 [-0.62, 0.46]），语言流畅性（k=5；g=-0.11 [-0.59, 0.38]），或自我监测/行为元认知（k=4；g=0.13 [-0.60, 0.86]）。跨域的池估计值虽达到了名义显著性（g=-0.18，p=0.035），但低于小效应阈值，其宽广的预测区间（95% PI [-1.01, 0.66]）跨越了获益与危害。进一步按诊断分组的探索性分析在 ADHD 和 ASD 中均为阴性（所有 p>0.10）。目前未标准化的“一刀切” NIBS 方案在 NDD 中未能产生可靠的认知增强，暴露了由方法学异质性驱动的翻译瓶颈。要在 NDD 中实现 NIBS 对认知的治疗潜力，需要转向精准精神病学，利用个体化神经导航和状态依赖性刺激。
